**Text-To-Image**

> A cinematic hand-drawn Japanese animated adventure film still in the style of Studio Ghibli, widescreen 16:9. A young boy with a rounded black bowl haircut sits facing the viewer on the wooden crossbench of a small weathered rowboat at sea. The camera looks slightly downward from close in front of him, showing his entire seated figure and the boat interior. He has large dark expressive eyes, small rosy cheeks, lifted eyebrows, and a slightly open mouth conveying surprise and concern. He wears a mustard-yellow hooded raincoat with large round buttons over a pale collared shirt, dark gray trousers rolled to mid-calf, and bare feet resting near the bottom of the frame. His knees are apart and each hand firmly grips the handle of a separate wooden oar, the two oars extending outward across the image.

> The boat fills most of the foreground, its curved sides narrowing toward the pointed bow behind his head. Show distressed blue paint on the inner hull, aged brown wooden ribs, rough planks, rope lashings around the oarlocks, and a coil of thick rope on the right. A large open terracotta storage jar sits prominently at the lower left; a tied tan sack rests behind him on the right. Dark blue-gray seawater surrounds the boat with small white ripples and broken reflections. Jagged coastal cliffs rise at the upper left, an isolated pointed sea stack stands in the upper-right distance, and a few small seabirds cross the cloudy horizon.

> Clean delicate ink outlines, expressive traditionally animated character design, restrained cel shading, and richly painted watercolor-and-gouache background textures. Diffused overcast daylight, muted slate blues, earthy browns, and a warm yellow focal point. Quiet tension, believable ocean atmosphere, carefully balanced perspective, crisp character details. No lettering, speech bubbles, logos, or watermark.
